description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'MapsProvider' for map-related operations, specifying required methods for searching places and getting directions.

classes.name: MapsProvider
classes.description: Abstract base class for map-related operations, requiring subclasses to implement asynchronous methods for searching places and fetching directions.

methods.description: Abstract method to compute directions between origin and destination, to be implemented by subclasses.
